title: Mike Levin - Live ALife 2020 Keynote - Robot Cancer
summary: Michael Levin's keynote at the ALife 2020 conference, 'Robot Cancer', on how bioelectric signaling in embryogenesis and regeneration informs unconventional computing, cognition and the 'software of life'. He argues biology offers lessons for building adaptive machines.
why: HN readers point to it as a companion to other Levin material on bioelectricity, goal-directedness in cells and cancer as a breakdown in cell communication.

quote.text: here is a similar keynote lecture from the same person, but a bit more recent and with a few other very interesting notes
